replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: I see math as a practical tool rather than a passion like literature. It's useful for my self-employed work, especially in budgeting and computer science applications. I appreciate its logic but find it less engaging than creative subjects. My background helps, but I prefer applying math to real-world problems over abstract theory.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Honestly, I rarely feel anxious about math. My low neuroticism score means I stay calm under pressure. If I encounter a problem, I'll just work through it methodically. Maybe other people feel overwhelmed, but I view challenges as puzzles to solve. My high conscientiousness keeps me focused without stress.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I tried using an AI tutor recently for some computer science concepts. It was helpful for quick explanations, though I still prefer human teachers for deeper understanding. The technology is promising, but I remain cautious about relying solely on it for complex mathematical reasoning.
